headline: Genuine Parts Company Discusses Potential Split at Automotive Symposium
summary: At its 50th annual automotive symposium, Genuine Parts Company discussed plans for a business split aimed at unlocking shareholder value.
why: Corporate restructuring and separation plans often unlock hidden asset value and alter the investment thesis for diversified industrial and retail holdings.

impacts.name: Genuine Parts Co
impacts.why: Corporate split discussions can drive valuation adjustments.
